## Physical Exam
VS: T 100.2F, HR 98, BP 138/84, RR 16, SpO2 98% RA
Gen: NAD, AOx4
L hand: two 0.5 cm puncture wounds dorsum over 3rd/4th metacarpals, surrounding erythema 6 x 5 cm, swelling, fluctuance. Full ROM of fingers, no tenosynovitis signs, sensation intact. No joint involvement.
Psych: calm, cooperative, appropriate
## Assessment / Plan
47M with infected dog bite L hand with cellulitis and small abscess.
1. Hand surgery consult - bedside vs OR washout
2. IV ampicillin-sulbactam, transition to PO amoxicillin-clavulanate when improving
3. Tdap given in ED; rabies PEP started in ED
4. X-ray L hand to r/o fracture/foreign body
5. MRSA nares PCR per protocol
6. Dispo - CM consult; unhoused, anticipate recuperative care
Isolation: None - standard precautions
